Optional follow-up: locate the source of the '<span> in <option>' hydration warning (search for any Select/option that renders a <span> child) and clean it up.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~4085 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into route-level modules (PaperTrading, MacroRegime, Terminal, Profile, WellingtonAI, Sidebar) to improve maintainability and reduce re-render surface.

Watchlist fix is correct: key={item.position} is guaranteed unique 1..50, whereas key={item.symbol} was duplicated (e.g., MSFT appears in 9 hedge-fund rows). Confirmed 0 duplicate-key errors in console during full watchlist render.
Macro Regime keys changed to indicator.name and asset — verified with 0 console errors on /macro.

rca of the issue.prior_iteration_bug: In iteration 4, /paper-trading watchlist rendered 50 items but used key={item.symbol}; because the seed generates top-5 stocks from 10 hedge funds, symbols like MSFT repeated up to 8-9 times, generating 136 React duplicate-key console errors.
rca of the issue.reproduction_before_fix: Navigate to /paper-trading and open dev console — errors 'Encountered two children with the same key' appear per repeated symbol per re-render.
rca of the issue.fix_applied: App.js line 1251 changed to key={item.position}. item.position is unique in the range 1..50 across all rendered rows.
rca of the issue.verification: Playwright browser test scrolled all 50 watchlist rows (positions #1..#50) and found 0 React duplicate-key warnings and 0 console errors during Paper Trading interactions. Clicking MSFT #18 (Two Sigma) correctly selects MSFT in Order Entry (screenshot confirms 'MSFT / Microsoft Corp / $381.58'). Also verified 8 additional MSFT rows exist under different hedge funds (Renaissance, Millennium, D.E. Shaw, Point72, Viking Global, Elliott, Baupost) — all with unique positions.
